title: AI Project Communities — Pattern Mining & Classification
summary: A corpus repository that bundles many unrelated third-party code projects as 'communities' for AI pattern-mining and classification research. One vendored community, a synthetic-data-generator (sdgx) folder, contains model wrapper classes whose docstrings show they wrap copulas.multivariate.GaussianMultivariate and a CTGAN-based model, so the copulas package from the SDV family arrives only as an inherited dependency inside vendored third-party source.
needs: This is a vendored copy of an unrelated project (sdgx) inside a code-corpus repo; unclear whether the copulas/ctgan-wrapping code is ever executed by this repo itself.
